title.narrative: Scaling up promising approaches for supporting people with disabilities and generating evidence of effectiveness

description.narrative: The project is testing whether proven approaches to including people with disabilities in development projects can be successfully scaled up. It tests what has and hasn't work and shares the resulting evidence, including some randomised-controlled trials. The interventions run in Uganda, Nigeria, Kenya, Tanzania, Bangladesh and Nepal.
